# thalassa_iam_policy (Resource)

Manage a project IAM policy in Thalassa Cloud. Requires projects to be enabled for the organisation (currently private beta).

See [IAM documentation](https://docs.thalassa.cloud/docs/iam/).


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the IAM policy

### Optional

- `annotations` (Map of String) Annotations for the IAM policy
- `description` (String) Description of the IAM policy
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels for the IAM policy
- `organisation_id` (String) Organisation of the IAM policy. If not provided, the organisation of the (Terraform) provider will be used.
- `replicate_to_children` (Boolean) When true, replicate this policy to child projects

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp of the IAM policy
- `id` (String) Identity of the IAM policy
- `is_read_only` (Boolean) Whether the IAM policy is read-only and cannot be modified
- `object_version` (Number) Object version of the IAM policy
- `slug` (String) Slug of the IAM policy
- `system` (Boolean) Whether the IAM policy is a system policy
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp of the IAM policy
